source: Client CSV 2026-10-14 (segmentation by product/technology, service/business model, application, end user, geography); cap 120, one browser per market, INDIA ONLY (owner 2026-10-14), state by state
market_definition: The India Commercial Drone Services Market covers companies delivering the following. Products and technology: Drone platform: multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL, specialized drone; payload: RGB, thermal, LiDAR, multispectral, spraying system; software: fleet management, remote ID, AI analytics. Services and business models: Aerial imaging, mapping/surveying, inspection, agriculture spraying, data analytics, MRO, training, rental/leasing, fleet management, BVLOS operations. Applications: Inspection and monitoring, mapping and surveying, aerial photography, precision agriculture, delivery, surveillance, disaster response, environmental monitoring. End users: Agriculture, construction, energy and utilities, oil and gas, mining, telecom, logistics, government, media, defense. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
core_scope: A core player itself operates commercial drone services for external clients under its own name: aerial imaging, mapping / surveying, inspection, agriculture spraying, drone data analytics, delivery, surveillance, MRO, training, rental / leasing, fleet management or BVLOS operations. Companies for which drone services are one business line qualify.
adjacent_segments: Drone hardware makers that only sell drones (no service operation)
Software-only drone platforms with no flight operations
Hobby / consumer drone retailers and distributors
Military UAV prime contractors with no commercial service
scope: ONLY companies HEADQUARTERED IN India. ONLY companies that operate in this market under their own name.
